description: The Lady Bird Lake Hike & Bike Trail, officially the Ann and Roy Butler Trail, is a 10-mile loop around the lake in central Austin, known for skyline views and a lakeside boardwalk.
name: Lady Bird Lake Hike & Bike Trail

description: Parque Los Fundadores is Playa del Carmen's beachfront main square at the foot of Quinta Avenida, home to the towering Portal Maya sculpture.
name: Parque Los Fundadores

description: Playa Delfines, also called Dolphin Beach, is a wide public beach on the southern stretch of Cancún's Hotel Zone, known for its hilltop mirador and the giant CANCÚN letters.
name: Playa Delfines

description: The Shops at La Cantera is an upscale open-air mall in northwest San Antonio, anchored by Neiman Marcus, Nordstrom, and Dillard's.
name: The Shops at La Cantera
